title: Goliards
content:
[[File:Aubrey_Beardsley_-_Pierrot_4.jpg|thumb|400px]]When drunk on holy beer, the [[Keepers of the Sainted Foot]] become '''goliards''', or holy jesters.

===Connections===

*One of the [[eleven recognised forms]] of Alberon is the goliard.
